What We Handle

Practice Areas

The Metyko Law Firm brings the discipline of a combat veteran and the precision of an MBA to every case. We know what matters — and what doesn't — because we've built businesses, led teams under pressure, and stood before juries.

Personal Injury

From car accidents to catastrophic injuries, we fight aggressively for maximum compensation. We handle cases on contingency — you pay nothing unless we win.

Commercial Trucking Accidents

Trucking cases are complex. We know the FMCSA regulations, black box data, and carrier liability frameworks. Whether you're injured or you're a carrier facing claims, we know this space inside and out.

Business Litigation

Contract disputes, DTPA claims, and commercial conflicts require a lawyer who understands business — not just law. Our MBA background means we know what's actually at stake.

Contract Review & Negotiations

We've built and sold businesses. We know which contract clauses cost companies millions — and which ones don't matter. Get real-world business insight in every review.

DTPA Claims (Trucking)

We represent commercial trucking companies in deceptive trade practice claims against mechanics, vendors, and service providers who fail to perform.

Carrier vs. Carrier Disputes

Experienced in representing trucking companies in disputes against other carriers — freight claims, liability allocation, and subrogation matters.

About the Firm

Mathews Metyko
Attorney at Law

2025 Established
50+ Cases Handled
Jury Verdicts Won

Before Mathews Metyko ever set foot in a courtroom, he served his country in Operation Enduring Freedom — learning firsthand what it means to perform under pressure, make decisive calls, and fight for the people depending on you.

That same mentality defines how he practices law. As a licensed Texas attorney, MBA, and serial entrepreneur, Mathews brings an uncommon combination of courtroom aggression and business acumen to every client he represents. He doesn't just know the law — he knows how business works, what contracts actually mean, and how to maximize what matters.

The Metyko Law Firm is intentionally boutique. That means you get Mathews — not a paralegal, not a junior associate. You get a trial attorney who has personally tried cases to verdict and will bring that same personal commitment to yours.

Operation Enduring Freedom Served as a U.S. Army officer before pursuing law. The same discipline that shaped his service defines his practice.
